svg.title: Fifty states, several legislative pathways
svg.desc: Equal-area tile cartogram. Each state is colored by its selected anchor pathway, not its full legal portfolio. Missouri proposal and DC research gap are unclassified. Numbers are category keys, not maturity scores.
svg.text: AEGISES / STATE AI LEGISLATIVE MATURITY / FIGURE 03
A national mosaic, not a league table
Representative anchors for all 50 states; the District of Columbia is shown separately.
